  Scenario Outline: User navigates the system with a simple and intuitive interface
    Given the system is ready for a Consultation Request

      | steps |

      | 10    |
      | 15    |

    Then the system displays an error message "<error_message>"

      | invalid_information | error_message                     |
      | ""                  | "Name cannot be empty"            |
      | "1234567890123456789012345678901234567890" | "Name is too long" |

    Given the system is ready for a Consultation Request
    When the user enters <edge_case_information> in the Consultation Request
    Then the Consultation Request is accepted without errors

      | edge_case_information |
      | "A"                   |
      | "John Doe"            |
      | "John_Doe123"         |

    As a user,

    So that I can install and use the system without issues.

      When the user follows the Installation Guide
      Then the system is installed successfully

    Scenario: User Manual is prepared

      When the user refers to the User Manual
      Then the user can perform basic operations in the system
